description: Repair creates a new immutable Candidate in the same case and requires a new human Review.
An exact replay of a successful Authority operation is idempotent.
Reusing an operationId with a different request fails closed.
Pre-Authority cancellation is control-only and prevents later lifecycle operations.
Cancellation after Authority acceptance cannot roll back accepted Authority.
Supersession requires a new case, new Candidate, new Review, and the exact current Authority head.
